castTime.binNote: Wiki states cast time 0.5s; bin's EkkoR.castTime field is 0.25, a disagreement. Reporting the wiki's stated value per instructions not to alter it to match the bin.

values.binNote: This is 4x the minimum heal (base amplified by up to 300% via PercentHealAmpPerPercentMissingHealth=3, i.e. 3% extra heal per 1% missing health, capped near 100% missing health); no direct bin row states 400/800 or 240% AP, it is derived from EkkoR#TotalBaseHeal amplified by the heal-amp formula.

mechanics.claim: Ekko enters stasis at the start of the cast time, becoming untargetable/immune during the cast and dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} at the start of the cast time

mechanics.claim: The heal is increased based on health lost in the last 4 seconds, scaling 3% healing per 1% of health lost.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=health lost|key=%|key1=%|type=health lost in the last 4 seconds|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of health lost in the last 4 seconds}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: Ekko dashes to the afterimage's location over 0.5 seconds before the stasis ends and the explosion occurs.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|dash|dashes}} to his ''afterimage's'' location at the time of cast over {{fd|0.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The explosion damage occurs only upon arrival at the afterimage location, ending the stasis.
mechanics.quote: Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Ekko is immune to displacements (airborne) during the whole ability.
mechanics.quote: '''''Ekko''' is immune to all {{tip|airborne|displacements}} during Chronobreak.''

mechanics.claim: The explosion still occurs even if the dash is interrupted.
mechanics.quote: The ''afterimage's'' location will explode even if '''Ekko's''' {{tip|dash}} is interrupted.
